sentences.text:
Raju @ Raja vs New India Insurance Company Limited on 2
April, 2026
 Neutral Citation No. 2026:Mphc-Ind:8716
 1 
 In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh

Before
 Hon'Ble Shri Justice Binod Kumar Dwivedi

Raju @ Raja
 Versus
 New India Insurance Company Limited And Others
 Appearance:
 Ms. Archana Maheshwari - Advocate for the appellant.
 Shri Anil Kumar Goyal - Advocate for the respondent [R-
 Order

This Miscellaneous Appeal has been preferred under Section 173(1) of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 against the impugned award dated 30.11.2023 passed by I Additional Member, Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Mandleshwar, Dist. Khargone (M.P.) in Claim Case No.31/2023, whereby an amount of Rs.1,42,000/- has been awarded to the appellant / injured with interest.

entities.text: I Additional Member, Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Mandleshwar, Dist. Khargone (M.P.)
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2. Learned counsel for the appellant submits that appellant has suffered grievous head injury and fracture in frontal bone, however, meager amount has been awarded by the learned Claims Tribunal.

He submits that if a lump s u m amount of Rs.1,00,000/- is awarded in addition to the amount already awarded by the learned Claims Tribunal that will sub serve the ends of justice.
Hence, prays for allowing the appeal by enhancing the award amount.
3 .

Per contra, learned counsel for the respondent / Insurance Company opposed the prayer on the ground that amount awarded by the learned Claims Tribunal is just and proper and no enhancement is required.
All the factors have been considered by the learned Claims Tribunal while awarding the compensation NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2026:MPHC-IND:8716 2 MA-1949-2024 amount.
Hence, prays for dismissal of the appeal.

4. Heard and considered the rival submissions raised at bar by learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
5.

Even though learned counsel for the Insurance Company has opposed the enhancement of the compensation amount, but he has not disputed the fact that appellant has suffered grievous head injury and fracture in frontal bone in a road traffic accident occurred on 04.01.2022, therefore,
Raju @ Raja vs New India Insurance Company Limited on 2 April, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/6491435/
1 without going into the nicety of the computation of the amount, the amount is enhanced and appellant / injured is entitled for an additional lump sum amount of Rs.1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lakh only) over and above the amount, which has been awarded by the Claims Tribunal.

entities.text: Raju @ Raja vs New India Insurance Company Limited
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 6. Resultantly, the appeal filed by the appellant is allowed to the extent as indicated hereinabove.
The other terms and conditions of the impugned award including the interest part shall remain intact.
The enhanced amount shall also carry interest at the same rate which has been fixed in the impugned award.

(BINOD KUMAR DWIVEDI) JUDGE soumya Raju @ Raja vs New India Insurance Company Limited on 2 April, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/6491435/
